summary: Tested the face recognition v2 work from both the backend and the UI. Backend: 24 pytest tests in test_iter18_face_recognition.py using synthesised unit-norm 128-d descriptors at exact distances. 23 pass and 1 fails because check-out never adds a clean match to the learned faces. These all work: 3-photo enrolment and its checks (400/400/403/409 plus face_enroll_blocked), the liveness check, rejecting frames from two different faces, rejecting a non-matching face, the impersonation block (403 + face_blocked), borderline matches flagged and not learned, learned list capped at 10 (check-in path), the migration (also checked by restarting the backend: a legacy user got a face_profiles doc with migrated:true), face reset, the face-checks list (filters, paging, pending_review, keep_days 7, sub-admin scope), review POST (ok/mismatch with note, 403 out of scope, 422 on bad kind, 404), and the selfie purge (401 without the secret; the 8-day-old record is cleared and today's is untouched). Frontend: Face Checks tab works for admin and sub-admin: cards, pending count, needs-review filter, person filter, date filters, 'Looks right' and 'Not them' (using the prompt) update the verdict and clear the pending count, and pagination 1/2 <-> 2/2 works with 26 records. The FaceCapture modal opens from My Day and shows the step instruction and steps. When camera access is blocked it shows face-error with tips and face-retry-btn, and Retry works. All face models load from /models/* with 200 (no github.io). No page errors or missing-export console errors. Ravi's My Day and /admin/reports load.

minor.issue: check_out() never calls learn_face(), so a clean checkout match (<=0.40) is not added to face_profiles.learned. Only check-in learns. The checkout response also leaves out face_distance and face_review, unlike check-in. Fix: add `await learn_face(user['user_id'], check)` after the update in check_out, and return face_distance/face_review.
Items do not include check_*_face_review_note, reviewed_by or reviewed_at, so the admin's note and who reviewed are never shown in the UI.

issues: 'Not them' uses the browser's window.prompt for the note. Cancelling the prompt silently cancels the whole mismatch decision. Use a shadcn Dialog with an optional note field.
From/To filters are native <input type=date>, not the shadcn Calendar/Popover.
The review note and reviewer are not shown on the card after a decision.

action_items: Call learn_face() in check_out (and return face_distance/face_review in the checkout response)
Replace window.prompt in FaceChecksTab review with a Dialog; replace native date inputs with shadcn Calendar
Return and display review note/reviewer in face-checks items
critical_code_review_comments: The liveness result is fully decided by the client: the backend only checks liveness.passed == true and that the challenge is 'blink' or 'turn'. Anyone calling the API directly can skip the live check. Mitigation: have the server choose the challenge and issue a short-lived nonce, then check that the per-frame descriptors vary a little (identical frames suggest a photo or replay).
Enrolment (/face/enroll) has no liveness requirement, so someone could enrol a printed photo.

closest_other() reads every face_profile on every check-in, check-out and enrolment and computes distances in Python. This is O(N employees x 13 templates) per request and will get slow for large orgs. Consider caching or a vector index.
The 'mismatch' review decision is only a label. It does not change the attendance status or alert anyone. Consider a follow-up action, such as marking the day for verification.
Object storage cannot delete, so the purge and face reset overwrite files with empty data. Photos from throwaway or deleted users stay in storage until someone overwrites them.
server.py is 3464 lines; the face, attendance and cron sections should be split into modules.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway field_staff users user_TEST_face_* with sessions, face_profiles and attendance; attendance records att_TEST_* for Ravi (flagged and pagination) and for purge testing; one legacy user user_TEST_migr01. All deleted by id/name afterwards, along with the activity_log rows they created. Known leftover: empty or test JPEGs in object storage (no delete API).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend && export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... MONGO_URL=... && pytest tests/test_iter18_face_recognition.py -p no:xdist -p no:randomly (the tests depend on running in order, sharing a module-scoped world fixture). The only expected failure is test_clean_checkout_learns, until check_out calls learn_face. Real faces cannot be produced in headless Chromium: its fake camera stream gets stuck at 'Centre your face in the ring'. To reach the error state, override getUserMedia with add_init_script. The Reports page route is /admin/reports, not /reports.
rca of the issue: Checkout learning: check_in() ends with `await learn_face(user['user_id'], check)`, but check_out() calls verify_face() and never calls learn_face. Reproduce by enrolling, checking in with a borderline face (flagged, so not learned), then checking out with a clean match (distance ~0.003): face_profiles.learned stays [] (test_clean_checkout_learns).
